def solution(lst):
    return sum([x for idx, x in enumerate(lst) if idx%2==0 and x%2==1])

# Unit test for function solution
def test_solution():
    # Odd number at even index â included
    assert solution([1, 2, 3]) == 4          # 1 (idx 0) + 3 (idx 2)
    assert solution([5, 0, 3, 0, 7]) == 15   # 5 + 3 + 7

    # Odd number at odd index â excluded
    assert solution([0, 1, 0, 3]) == 0

    # Even numbers only â nothing included
    assert solution([2, 4, 6, 8]) == 0

    # Empty list
    assert solution([]) == 0

    # Negative odd numbers (x%2==1 works for negatives in Python: -3%2 == 1)
    assert solution([-3, 2, -5, 4, -7]) == -15  # -3 + -5 + -7

    # Single element
    assert solution([7]) == 7
    assert solution([8]) == 0

    print("All tests passed!")

test_solution()
